A moment we once dreamed of… is now a reality. 💙✨

From a small home setup to our very own store — this journey has been filled with passion, patience, and the unwavering support of our beautiful brides and well-wishers.

Today, we proudly open the doors to Winston Blue Premium Rentals at Vazhakkala, Kakkanad. 💍
This is more than just a store… it’s a milestone, a memory, and a dream come true.

Every step we took over the past 6 years led us to this day. And none of this would have been possible without your trust and love.

As we begin this new chapter, we carry forward the same promise — to make every bride feel special, confident, and beautiful.

Thank you for being a part of our journey. We need your continued blessings and support always. 💫

Our doors are now open. Welcome to Winston Blue. 🤍

#WinstonBlue #GrandOpening #Vazhakkala #Kakkanad #NewBeginnings DreamToReality

A dream come true moment! 💌😍
The day I found my best friend getting engaged to the love of her life was beyond words. To say I’m shocked would be an understatement, but it’s the kind of shock that quickly turns into joy, tears, butterflies, and the biggest smile on my face. 

I feel like my heart is dancing. I’m thrilled, I’m honored, I’m EMOTIONAL. Watching you both, knowing the kind of people you are—so full of love, laughter, and loyalty—I know this is going to be one heck of a beautiful journey. And I can’t lie... I’m also super excited for all the wedding madness, the photos, the dancing, the behind-the-scenes chaos... and the chance to celebrate both of you in the way you truly deserve.

From being your friend to now witnessing your love story unfold—I can’t wait to see what’s next. You two are made for each other, and I’m so grateful I get to be part of this incredible ride.

Congratulations on your engagement Fidha & Abi❤️
Let the love, laughter, and (slight) drama continues. 💍💃🥂

With love,
Fara.
